method: Built-in imagegen; three original environments, new landscape assets; no third-party game recordings or paid external services

prompts.grove: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original game arena environment, high-quality 1536x1024 landscape. Premium sculpted stylised 3D fantasy world, tactile painted stone, lavender/gold palette consistent with anthropomorphic purple creature fighters with brass/ivory armour. EMPTY environment, no characters, creatures, UI, labels, text or watermarks. Side-on three-quarter duel camera, horizon around 45 percent, solid broad continuous fighting floor occupying lower 45 percent. Two opposing fighters will stand around x25% and x75%, feet at y78%. Quiet low-contrast scenery behind their silhouettes and HUD; ornamental architecture concentrated at extreme edges and distance. No foreground obstructions or obstacles. Floor stable and level; small central circular brass inlay. Broad clear central arena, enough floor for portrait center crop. Warm upper-left key with cool lavender fill; readable materials and depth, no heavy blur. Scene: Moonlit Grove, luminous woodland clearing with ancient low lavender stone dais, moonlight through tall trees around far left and right, faint teal/lilac bioluminescent foliage, distant tiny fireflies, subtle gold stone inlays. Calm quiet green/lilac scenery, solid flat stone/earth clearing, no glowing neon carpet.
